professional.linkedin_headline: Senior Full Stack Engineer with 4+ years of experience building enterprise application
professional.linkedin_summary: Senior Full Stack Engineer with 4+ years of experience building scalable, enterprise-grade insurance platforms using Angular (v11–21) and Java Spring Boot (Java 21). Proven track record of delivering 20+ production features across the full stack — from Angular/NgRx/RxJS frontends to Spring Boot Microservices secured with Spring Security (JWT, RBAC) and data layers built on JPA/Hibernate with PostgreSQL. Architected and owned 12+ Angular modules with lazy loading, OnPush change detection, and reusable component libraries — improving application performance by 30–35%. On the backend, designed Microservices, implemented REST APIs, managed database migrations, and resolved critical JPA/Hibernate query issues including N+1 optimisation. Experienced with AWS (EC2, RDS, S3) for cloud deployment and CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins.
